# @k8ordo/state

> Declare state by where it lives: `definePageState` (typed URL search params
> plus hidden history-entry state — the two faces of one entry, updated
> atomically over the Navigation API), `defineLocalState` (localStorage,
> cross-tab), `defineSessionState` (sessionStorage — the same store over the
> per-tab area: survives a reload, gone with the tab), `defineCookieState` (a
> cookie the browser writes with the Cookie Store API and the server reads
> from the request, so preferences render without a flash of the default —
> never a secret, it cannot be `HttpOnly`), `defineMemoryState` (a typed
> shared box with no schema, resets on reload). One zod schema per boundary
> place (url, entry, local, session, cookie) derives the server read,
> canonical links, salvage of stale data, and a client subscription with
> exact per-key change detection. Links and GET forms write the URL before
> JavaScript loads under any router (the server renders what they wrote
> wherever it reads the search); imperative url updates ride a
> Navigation-API-intercepting router.
>
> Like every k8ordo package it assumes React 19 and Server Components, uses
> only what has reached Baseline newly available, and ships no polyfills or
> legacy fallbacks.

When installed via npm, these docs live under `node_modules/@k8ordo/state/docs/`.

## Guide

- [Design Guide](GUIDE.md): the places and when each fits, the shared
  definition module, reading on the server, cookie state the server renders
  (and how it relates to cookies the server writes), updating on the client,
  batching and update handles, subscription granularity, router
  requirements, typed routes via `Register`, reading local state before
  hydration, and pairing with `@k8ordo/form` for GET forms.

## Entry point

- `@k8ordo/state` — `definePageState(key, { url?, entry? })` returns a pure
  definition usable from server and client: `parseUrl(searchParams)` reads
  the url slot typed with defaults applied and invalid values salvaged
  (wherever the router hands a page its search — under `@k8ordo/static` /
  `@k8ordo/server` a page receives `params` and `pathname` (plus a
  headers-and-cookies `request` under `@k8ordo/server`) but never the search,
  and the url slot is read in the browser);
  `href(path, values?)` builds a canonical link keeping the path literal in
  the type — the path written from the app's root, the link carrying Vite's
  `base` (`import.meta.env.BASE_URL`) in front; `search(values?)` returns the
  query string alone.
  `defineLocalState(key, schema)`, `defineSessionState(key, schema)`,
  `defineCookieState(key, schema)` and `defineMemoryState(key, initial)`
  declare app-scope state; a local or session definition also exposes
  `storageKey` (the key in its storage area, `k8ordo-state:<key>`) and
  `inlineRead()`, a JavaScript expression for an inline `<script>` that
  evaluates to the object stored in that area or `null` before hydration —
  unvalidated, so read only what you need with a fallback. A
  cookie definition exposes `cookieName` (`k8ordo-state.<key>`),
  `parseCookies(cookies)` — reads the values out of a request's
  percent-decoded cookies (`request.cookies` under `@k8ordo/server`), salvaged
  like any read — and `cookieValue(values?)`, the value a server writes when
  it sets the same cookie (`Path=/`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Max-Age=34560000`,
  never `HttpOnly`). `useAppState(definition, keys?, { initialUrl? } |
  { initialCookie? })` (client) works on any kind and returns
  `[state, update]` — state is the flat merge of a page definition's slots;
  `initialUrl` / `initialCookie` seed the server and hydration renders with
  what the server read; `update(patch)` applies synchronously, batches the
  calls a handler makes with no `await` between them into one write
  (url+entry changes atomically via `navigation.navigate()`, entry-only
  changes via `updateCurrentEntry()`, local and session via one `setItem`,
  cookie via one
  `cookieStore.set()`; memory applies per call), and returns
  `{ committed, finished }` promise handles (for non-navigating kinds they
  settle once the write lands, and a write the browser refuses — a full
  Web Storage area, a cookie over 4 KB — rejects them with its error;
  `{ history: 'push' }` exists only on page state and takes effect only when
  a url value changes).
  `resetStateRegistry()` clears stores between tests. Augment
  `interface Register { routes: typeof routes }` — the same line as for
  `@k8ordo/router` — to check each `href` path against the route table's
  linkable patterns segment by segment (`NavigablePath`, so a `/:locale`
  table no longer takes every path); a router without a table registers its own path union as
  `interface Register { path }` instead.
